test_launch_program: test launching a Launchpad program as a multithreaded integration test with automatic failure detection
run_launch_with_test_case: run the launch function with an absltest.TestCase to register automatic cleanup on test completion
run_launch_serialize_nodes: run launch with serialize_py_nodes enabled to check that nodes are serializable before connecting input handles
review_launch_node_monitoring: review the background node monitor thread that detects worker exceptions and kills the process on uncaught failures
build_launch_worker_manager: build a WorkerManager instance (v1 or v2) to manage thread workers for a Launchpad program
